lead.title: Delhi's air quality slips into 'severe' category on Diwali; Mumbai's AQI at 170
lead.summary: Delhi experienced a significant decline in air quality overnight, with areas recording severe pollution levels. The Central Pollution Control Board reported an Air Quality Index of 406 at ITO, indicating hazardous conditions. Visibility was greatly reduced as a thick layer of smog enveloped the city during the early morning hours. Rajiv Chowk and South Extension also reported very poor air quality readings.

lead.title: Wisconsin couple manages 500-acre forest for wildlife, eyes $10,000 award
lead.summary: Jesse and Kylie Sebero are managing over 500 acres of forest in Marinette County, Wisconsin. They focus on timber production while ensuring ecological balance and wildlife conservation. The couple also opens their land for educational tours, helping others learn about forest management. They have been nominated for the 2026 Wisconsin Leopold Conservation Award for their significant contributions.

The innovation generates taluka-level estimates to support informed water management.
